newsitem.title: UK: Result of Sri Lanka sugar tender remains unclear.
newsitem.headline: Result of Sri Lanka sugar tender remains unclear.

text.p: Confusion surrounded the result of Sri Lanka's sugar tender in the London market on Thursday.
Traders were unclear whether Sri Lanka bought 12,500 tonnes of lesser-quality white sugar at its recent tender or had decided to reinvite bids for later this week.
London traders said the country's state buying arm, the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment (CWE), bought the sugar at $343.00 a tonne c & f from a European trading house.
But traders in Colombo said the CWE had asked suppliers to resubmit bids before Friday. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
